subject: Disability Pride Day Planning
overview: The commission initiated planning for an April Disability Pride event and a resource fair while reviewing urgent ADA accessibility failures at Medford High School. Members also established a logo subcommittee, elected a secretary, and prepared for a new website launch.

items.title: Introductions and Minutes
items.summary: The commission held routine introductions for new members and approved the amended minutes from the November/December meeting.

items.title: Website Update
items.summary: Members discussed the upcoming transition to an updated city website and identified specific accessibility resources and recreational links to be vetted for inclusion.

items.title: Logo Design Subcommittee
items.summary: Approved forming a subcommittee to develop a commission logo and identity in collaboration with the Medford Public Library and high school graphic arts department.

items.title: Disability Pride Day and High School ADA Issues
items.summary: Discussed organizing an April Disability Pride Day event featuring a resource fair and film screening, while reviewing physical accessibility barriers at Medford High School including non-compliant entrances and lack of curb cuts.

items.title: Correspondence and Announcements
items.summary: Noted upcoming MBTA accessibility meetings, the Federation for Children with Special Needs conference, and local adaptive theater performances.
